avis.titre: As good as more expensive brands
avis.texte: I've been using this for over a year and it's great for aging skin. I'm in my mid-50s now and dry, inelastic skin is a big deal. This is just as good as most more expensive brands. I use it at night before bed and morning before makeup.
Why did you pick this product vs others?: I’ve been using this product for 20 years. It’s one of my favorites.

Bought it for my Lady. She looked at me and asked, "Are you sure? Is this good stuff, or just something off the Net?" Gotta luv her, cuz she won't just use crap on her face lol... Sent her the description and she has used it since. She tells me that it is 'Good Stuff', that's good enuff for me!

I've been using this cream for over 20 years, but now that my skin is maturing, it's not as effective. I've started getting closed comedones, and it doesn't nourish my dry skin like it used to. It's great for younger skin, though.

avis.titre: Another high quality Vichy product, wish it came in an airless pump container as opposed to a jar
avis.texte: Great all around facial moisturizer. Not sure what about it is "thermal" (pls see pic i attached of box if you have time).. It is fragrance & paraben free so my sensitive skin didnt have any adverse negative reaction to this. I noticed that my face looked rehydrated & fresh after application. It was the same when I woke up the following morning. I'm a fan of vichy products...I'm just not a fan of any cream/products that come in a jar. I would have preferred that a small spatula for dispensing was included in the package. The ingredient quality is good & consistent with the other Vichy products I've tried in the past.

This Vichy Aqualia Thermal Face Cream Moisturizer was available to me through the Amazon Vine program. (Vichy is a city in France.) This cream contains Vichy volcanic water, hyaluronic acid and glycerin to hydrate and soothe dry skin. I ordered the fragrance free variety, which has a light scent. It is suggested to apply twice daily, alone or over serum. I find the cream moisturizes okay, but it leaves skin a bit sticky. So to me, it is not worth its price.
The first time I ordered this product it arrived with a broken lid. This time it arrived with broken tape seal and ripped packaging box. I hope the cream is not contaminated or touched.
